_method: Manual adjudication of the composer's root_cause against each ticket's label. Done once: the composer's output is byte-identical across the verifier-ON and verifier-OFF runs (verified), so the same judgement applies to both. An LLM judge was rejected here - having a model grade a system built around a model's judgement invites exactly the circularity this evaluation is trying to avoid - at the cost that the adjudicator (me) built the system, which is its own bias and is why every call is recorded below rather than just the totals.

_categories.WRONG: states a different cause, or asserts something false
_categories.REFUSED: produced no substantive causal claim at all (fail-closed); neither right nor wrong, excluded from the headline correct/wrong split

_multi_cause_rule: For a label with several causes, CORRECT if the root_cause matches any of them (root_cause is a single field). An OMITTED second cause is noted but still CORRECT; an ASSERTED false statement is WRONG. Omission and commission are not the same failure.
